arxiv-1910-03315.title: Quantum linear network coding for entanglement distribution in restricted architectures
arxiv-1910-03315.creator: Niel de Beaudrap, Steven Herbert
arxiv-1910-03315.description: Abstract In this paper we propose a technique for distributing entanglement in architectures in which interactions between pairs of qubits are constrained to a fixed network G G . This allows for two-qubit operations to be performed between qubits which are remote from each other in G G , through gate teleportation.

arxiv-2102-07012.title: Essential m-dissipativity and hypocoercivity of Langevin dynamics with multiplicative noise
arxiv-2102-07012.creator: Alexander Bertram ,, Martin Grothaus ,
arxiv-2102-07012.description: Abstract We provide a complete elaboration of the L 2 L^{2} -Hilbert space hypocoercivity theorem for the degenerate Langevin dynamics with multiplicative noise, studying the longtime behavior of the strongly continuous contraction semigroup solving the abstract Cauchy problem for the associated backward Kolmogorov operator.

arxiv-2108-03973.title: BERT-based distractor generation for Swedish reading comprehension questions using a small-scale dataset
arxiv-2108-03973.creator: Dmytro Kalpakchi, Johan Boye
arxiv-2108-03973.description: Abstract An important part when constructing multiple-choice questions (MCQs) for reading comprehension assessment are the distractors , the incorrect but preferably plausible answer options. In this paper, we present a new BERT-based method for automatically generating distractors using only a small-scale dataset.

arxiv-2112-06827.title: Making Fanaroff-Riley I radio sources
arxiv-2112-06827.creator: S. Massaglia, G. Bodo, P. Rossi, A. Capetti, A. Mignone
arxiv-2112-06827.description: Abstract Extragalactic radio sources appear under different morphologies, the most frequent ones are classified as Fanaroff-Riley type I (FR I), typically with lower luminosities, and Fanaroff-Riley type II, (FR II), typically more luminous. This simple classification, however, has many exceptions that we intend to investigate.

arxiv-2207-04936.title: PL homeomorphisms of surfaces and codimension 2 2 PL foliations
arxiv-2207-04936.creator: Sam Nariman
arxiv-2207-04936.description: Abstract . Haefliger–Thurston’s conjecture predicts that Haefliger’s classifying space for C r C^{r} -foliations of codimension n n whose normal bundles are trivial is 2 ​ n 2n -connected. In this paper, we confirm this conjecture for PL foliations of codimension 2 2 .

arxiv-2211-13652.title: The GA-cal software for the automatic calibration of soil constitutive laws: a tutorial and a user manual
arxiv-2211-13652.creator: Francisco J. Mendez, Miguel A. Mendez, Antonio Pasculli
arxiv-2211-13652.description: Abstract The calibration of an advanced constitutive law for soil is a challenging task. This work describes GA-cal, a Fortran software for automatically calibrating constitutive laws using Genetic Algorithms (GA) optimization. The proposed approach sets the calibration problem as a regression, and the GA optimization is used to adjust the model parameters so that a numerical model matches experimental data.

arxiv-2310-06823.title: NECO: NEural Collapse Based Out-of-distribution detection
arxiv-2310-06823.creator: Mouïn Ben Ammar, Nacim Belkhir, Sebastian Popescu, Antoine Manzanera, Gianni Franchi, U2IS Lab ENSTA Paris, Palaiseau, FRANCE, SafranTech, Chateaufort 78117, FRANCE, {first.last}@enstaparis.com, safrangroup.com
arxiv-2310-06823.description: Abstract Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) data is a critical challenge in machine learning due to model overconfidence, often without awareness of their epistemological limits. We hypothesize that “neural collapse”, a phenomenon affecting in-distribution data for models trained beyond loss convergence, also influences OOD data.

arxiv-2312-03963.title: Regional Greening as a ‘Positive’ Tipping Phenomenon
arxiv-2312-03963.creator: Yu Sun, Teng Liu, Shang Wang, Jun Meng, Yongwen Zhang, Saini Yang, Xiaosong Chen, Deliang Chen, Jürgen Kurths, Shlomo Havlin, Hans Joachim Schellnhuber, Jingfang Fan
arxiv-2312-03963.description: Abstract Earth system tipping elements have been predominantly investigated for their potential to trigger negative ecological, climatic, and societal shifts. Yet, an overlooked but seminal avenue exists in the form of positive tipping phenomena, whose underlying mechanisms and benefits remain largely underexplored.

arxiv-2410-06684.title: Effect of Dielectric Wakefields in a Capillary Discharge for Plasma Wakefield Acceleration Journal: NIMA - Proceedings of the 2024 Advanced Accelerator Concepts workshop
arxiv-2410-06684.creator: L. Verra, M. Galletti, R. Pompili, A. Biagioni, M. Carillo, A. Cianchi, L. Crincoli, A. Curcio, F. Demurtas, G. Di Pirro, V. Lollo, G. Parise, D. Pellegrini, S. Romeo, G.J. Silvi, F. Villa, M. Ferrario
arxiv-2410-06684.description: Abstract Dielectric capillaries are widely used to generate plasmas for plasma wakefield acceleration. When a relativistic drive bunch travels through a capillary with misaligned trajectory with respect to the capillary axis, it is deflected by the effect of the dielectric transverse wakefields it drives.

arxiv-2412-11897.title: A vanishing theorem in Siefring’s intersection theory
arxiv-2412-11897.creator: Naageswaran Manikandan
arxiv-2412-11897.description: Abstract . In 2009, R. Siefring introduced a homotopy-invariant generalized intersection number and singularity index for punctured pseudoholomorphic curves, by adding contributions from the curve’s asymptotic behavior to the standard intersection number and singularity index. In this article, we provide a stratification of the moduli space that describes the rate of asymptotic convergence of the pseudoholomorphic curves.

arxiv-2502-11701.title: A Cholesky decomposition-based asset selection heuristic for sparse tangent portfolio optimization
arxiv-2502-11701.creator: Hyunglip Bae, Haeun Jeon, Minsu Park, Yongjae Lee, Woo Chang Kim
arxiv-2502-11701.description: Abstract In practice, including large number of assets in mean-variance portfolios can lead to higher transaction costs and management fees. To address this, one common approach is to select a smaller subset of assets from the larger pool, constructing more efficient portfolios.

arxiv-2601-03012.title: Many-electron systems with fractional electron number and spin: exact properties above and below the equilibrium total spin value
arxiv-2601-03012.creator: Yuli Goshen, Eli Kraisler
arxiv-2601-03012.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuli Goshen, Eli Kraisler. Description of many-electron systems with a fractional electron number, N tot N_{\textrm{tot}} , and fractional z z -projection of the spin, M tot M_{\textrm{tot}} , is of great importance in physical chemistry, solid-state physics and materials science.

arxiv-2602-22173.title: Applying a Random-Key Optimizer on Mixed Integer Programs
arxiv-2602-22173.creator: Antonio A. Chaves, Mauricio G.C. Resende, Carise E. Schmidt, J. Kyle Brubaker, Helmut G. Katzgraber
arxiv-2602-22173.description: Abstract Mixed-Integer Programs (MIPs) are NP-hard optimization models that arise in a broad range of decision-making applications, including finance, logistics, energy systems, and network design. Although modern commercial solvers have achieved remarkable progress and perform effectively on many small- and medium-sized instances, their performance often degrades when confronted with large-scale or highly constrained formulations.

plos-pone-0355390.creator: YueXin Chen, NingNa Zhang, YanYing Zhu, HaiYan Xie, YuKun Liu, Ke Zhang, XiaoChen Xu, Jing Wang
plos-pone-0355390.description: One-year effects of orthokeratology lens wear on objective visual quality and corneal densitometry in adolescents with myopia

pmc-10610673.title: Replacing Harmful Flame Retardants with Biodegradable Starch-Based Materials in Polyethylene Formulations
pmc-10610673.creator: Bárbara O. Carvalho, Luís P. C. Gonçalves, Patrícia V. Mendonça, João P. Pereira, Arménio C. Serra, Jorge F. J. Coelho
pmc-10610673.description: The addition of toxic flame retardants to commercially available polymers is often required for safety reasons due to the high flammability of these materials. In this work, the preparation and incorporation of efficient biodegradable starch-based flame retardants into a low-density polyethylene (LDPE) matrix was investigated.

pmc-10731554.title: ChatGPT Versus Consultants: Blinded Evaluation on Answering Otorhinolaryngology Case–Based Questions
pmc-10731554.creator: Christoph Raphael Buhr, Harry Smith, Tilman Huppertz, Katharina Bahr-Hamm, Christoph Matthias, Andrew Blaikie, Tom Kelsey, Sebastian Kuhn, Jonas Eckrich
pmc-10731554.description: BackgroundLarge language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT (Open AI), are increasingly used in medicine and supplement standard search engines as information sources. This leads to more “consultations” of LLMs about personal medical symptoms.ObjectiveThis study aims to evaluate ChatGPT’s performance in answering clinical case–based questions in otorhinolaryngology (ORL) in comparison to ORL consultants’ answers.

pmc-11308599.title: HPV integration: a precise biomarker for detection of residual/recurrent disease after treatment of CIN2-3
pmc-11308599.creator: Fanwei Huang, Liang He, Wei Li, Xiaoyuan Huang, Tao Zhang, Munawaer Muaibati, Hu Zhou, Shimin Chen, Wenhui Yang, Fan Yang, Liang Zhuang, Ting Hu
pmc-11308599.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate whether persistent human papillomavirus integration at the same loci (PHISL) before and after treatment can predict recurrent/residual disease in women with CIN2-3.MethodsA total of 151 CIN2-3 women treated with conization between August 2020 and September 2021 were included. To investigate the precision of HPV integration, we further analyzed HPV integration-positive patients.

pmc-11432245.title: PRC1 Protein Subcomplexes Architecture: Focus on the Interplay between Distinct PCGF Subunits in Protein Interaction Networks
pmc-11432245.creator: Nayla Munawar, Kieran Wynne, Giorgio Oliviero
pmc-11432245.description: The six PCGF proteins (PCGF1-6) define the biochemical identity of Polycomb repressor complex 1 (PRC1) subcomplexes. While structural and functional studies of PRC1 subcomplexes have revealed their specialized roles in distinct aspects of epigenetic regulation, our understanding of the variation in the protein interaction networks of distinct PCGF subunits in different PRC1 complexes is incomplete.

pmc-11494205.title: Association of ultra-processed food consumption with cardiovascular risk factors among patients with type-2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-11494205.creator: Mohammad Heidari Seyedmahalleh, Ensieh Nasli-Esfahani, Mobina Zeinalabedini, Leila Azadbakht
pmc-11494205.description: BackgroundUltra-processed foods mainly have high energy content and density and low nutrients. Unhealthy lifestyles mainly develop cardiovascular diseases and, as a result, unhealthy food patterns.ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate the relationship between the consumption of ultra-processed foods (UPFs) and the risk of novel cardiovascular disease (CVDs) in type-2 diabetes mellitus patients (T2DM).

pmc-11691723.title: PLASMA PROTEOMIC SIGNATURE OF DEVELOPMENT AND PROGNOSIS OF PHYSICAL FRAILTY
pmc-11691723.creator: Jianhong Xu, jingyun Liu, Jinhui Liao, Chenkai Wu
pmc-11691723.description: The complete understanding of biological mechanisms behind frailty remains elusive. We aimed to investigate the proteomic signature associated with the development and prognosis of frailty. Data from 43,895 participants (aged 39-70 years) in the UK Biobank were analyzed, with 2,920 proteins assayed using Olink. Participants were split into development and validation cohorts based on geographic location.

pmc-11745031.title: The Motor Melody in action Planning: The Case of Autistic Children and their Non-Autistic Siblings
pmc-11745031.creator: Maria Chiara Bazzini, Antonio Narzisi, Gaia Scarpini, Emilia Scalona, Gianina Bruzzi, Angela Russo, Valentina Viglione, Gabriele Masi, Giacomo Rizzolatti, Cristina Berchio, Maddalena Fabbri-Destro
pmc-11745031.description: Objectiveit is well known that during an intentional behavior, the final goal of the action shapes the entire sequence of motor acts. This chained organization has been previously demonstrated to be altered in school-age autistic children, who modulate only the final motor act according to the action goal.

pmc-11884345.title: FDG PET Scan in Cutaneous Rosai–Dorfman–Destombes Disease
pmc-11884345.creator: Shrikant Vasantrao Solav, Chakor Vora, Rajlaxmi Jagtap, Shailendra Savale, Ishtiyaq Shaikh, Aman Solav
pmc-11884345.description: Rosai–Dorfman–Destombes (RDD) disease is also called as sinus histiocytosis and is characterized by enlarged lymph nodes and previously called as non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis. Based on pathologic, molecular, and genetic features, RDD disease has been classified into sporadic noncutaneous (classical nodal, extranodal, neoplasia associated, and autoimmune associated), familial (H syndrome, autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome related, and familial NOS), and cutaneous subtypes.

pmc-12469365.title: Minigene Splice Assays Allow Pathogenicity Reclassification of RPE65 Variants of Uncertain Significance
pmc-12469365.creator: Daan M Panneman, Erica G M Boonen, Zelia Corradi, Frans P M Cremers, Susanne Roosing, Claudia Ricci
pmc-12469365.description: Background/objectives: Obtaining a genetic diagnosis for patients with inherited retinal diseases has become even more important since gene-specific therapies have become available. When genetic screening reveals variants of uncertain significance (VUS), additional evidence is required to determine genetic eligibility for therapy.

pmc-12508150.title: Exogenous kisspeptin-10 treatment shows pleiotropy via induction of KISS1 expression, metastasis suppression, and promotes apoptosis in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-12508150.creator: Hetvi Shah, Adikrishna Murali Mohan, Lipi Buch, A V Ramachandran, Parth Pandya
pmc-12508150.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype lacking ER, PR, and HER2 receptors making it highly clinically challenging subtype pf breast cancer. In this study, we investigated the effect of exogenous Kisspeptin-10 (Kp-10), on MDA-MB-231 and MDA-MB-468 cells. TNBC cells using both in vitro and in silico approaches.

pmc-12533471.title: Corynebacterium pseudotuberculosis phospholipase D targets mitochondrial sphingomyelin and induces NLRP3-GSDMD axis-mediated pyroptosis in macrophages to promote infection
pmc-12533471.creator: Xincan Li, Hong Lv, Chanyu Wu, Hexian Li, Wenyi Yi, Xiaoxin Niu, Qiuyue Peng, Chi Meng, Yongfeng Yuan, Shangquan Tian, Zhiying Wang, Rendong Fang, Zuoyong Zhou
pmc-12533471.description: Infection by Corynebacterium pseudotuberculosis (Cp), a facultative intracellular bacterium, causes mainly purulent inflammation and chronic granulomas in animals and humans. Pyroptosis is a proinflammatory form of programmed cell death that is important in response to pathogen infection. The role of pyroptosis in Cp infection and the related mechanisms are still unclear.

pmc-12584767.title: Lower airway microbiota compositions and diversity among ventilator-associated pneumonia patients across COVID-19 epidemic phases: a retrospective study
pmc-12584767.creator: Shengyu Hao, Chujun Zhou, Yilin Wei, Yuxian Wang, Pan Jiang, Jieqiong Song, Ming Zhong
pmc-12584767.description: Ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) is a major cause of morbidity in critically ill patients, and the SARS-CoV-2 infection has influenced the lung microbiome. This study aimed to examine the lower respiratory tract microbiome in VAP patients during different phases of the Shanghai COVID-19 epidemic.

pmc-12650006.title: Protective Role of Thiamine Pyrophosphate Against Erlotinib-Induced Oxidative and Inflammatory Damage in Rat Optic Nerve
pmc-12650006.creator: Ezgi Karatas, Bulent Yavuzer, Ozlem Demir, Esra Tuba Sezgin, Engin Hendem, Emine Cinici, Taha Abdulkadir Coban, Halis Suleyman, Christos Bakirtzis, Evangelia Kesidou, Iliana Michailidou
pmc-12650006.description: Background: Epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) such as erlotinib are widely used in non-small-cell lung cancer treatment, and accumulating evidence indicates they can markedly increase ocular toxicity. Nonetheless, whether erlotinib causes optic nerve injury has not been investigated before and remains a subject worth investigating.

pmc-12671270.title: Student Perceptions of Cognitive, Psychomotor and Affective Learning in the Undergraduate Laboratory
pmc-12671270.creator: Alexandra Cleaver, Lauren Crean, Susan Howitt
pmc-12671270.description: Biochemistry and molecular biology is an experimental discipline and therefore training students in experimental techniques and data analysis is an essential component of undergraduate degrees. However, the amount of practical work may be limited by financial constraints and can vary considerably in the quality of the student experience.

pmc-13167471.title: CREsted: modeling genomic and synthetic cell-type-specific enhancers across tissues and species
pmc-13167471.creator: Niklas Kempynck, Seppe De Winter, Casper H Blaauw, Vasileios Konstantakos, Eren Can Ekşi, Sam Dieltiens, Darina Abaffyová, Valérie Bercier, Ibrahim I Taskiran, Gert Hulselmans, Katina Spanier, Valerie Christiaens, Ludo Van Den Bosch, Lukas Mahieu, Stein Aerts
pmc-13167471.description: Sequence-based deep learning models have become the state of the art for analyzing the genomic regulatory code. Particularly for enhancers, these models excel at deciphering sequence grammar that underlies their activity. To enable end-to-end enhancer modeling and design, we developed a software package called CREsted (cis-regulatory element sequence training, explanation and design).

pmc-13186711.title: Comparative analysis of ARIMA and Holt-Winter’s additive models for describing human respiratory syncytial virus activity in Yaoundé, Cameroon
pmc-13186711.creator: Moise Henri Moumbeket-Yifomnjou, Chavely Gwladys Monamele, Desmon Toutou Tsafack, Mohamadou Ripa Njankouo, Aristide Mounchili-Njifon, Paul Alain Tagnouokam-Ngoupo, Abdou Fatawou Modiyinji, Boyomo Onana, Richard Njouom
pmc-13186711.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesHuman respiratory syncytial virus (HRSV) is a major cause of respiratory infections in children and older adults. This study compared the Autoregressive Integrative Moving Average (ARIMA) and Holt-Winter’s Additive models to describe HRSV activity in Yaoundé, Cameroon.MethodsIn a three-year retrospective study (July 2020–December 2022), analyzed 1,774 nasopharyngeal samples from patients with severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) and influenza-like illness (ILI) were analysed across five sentinel sites in Yaoundé.
